title: Tupul Railway Construction Yard Landslide, Noney (Manipur)
summary: At midnight on 29-30 June 2022, a massive rotational debris slide and mudflow occurred at the railway construction camp near Tupul station on the Jiribam-Imphal railway line. The landslide blocked the Ijei river, creating an artificial dam and inundating the 107 Territorial Army company camp.
geotechnical_context: Deep slope cutting without adequate retaining structures, high pore water pressure following continuous heavy monsoon precipitation on sheared Disang shale formations.

response_actions.action: Mobilized 5 search and rescue teams with sniffer dogs and through-the-wall radar devices
Heavy earthmoving machinery deployed to breach the Ijei river landslide dam and prevent flash flooding downstream
Evacuation of downstream habitations along the Ijei river corridor
